name: Door Frame Paint Prep (Post-Primer)
intent: Inspect cured primer on each door frame, light sand to break the surface, touch up any caulk gaps or fill misses, clean dust before finish coats. Per-frame rates (EA) rather than LF because frames are discrete units with heterogeneous piece-count.

tasks.name: Inspect Primed Door Frame
tasks._doctrine_note: Estimated from trim inspect rate (800 LF/hr) scaled for one frame ~= 17 LF. Rounded to 30 EA/hr.

tasks.name: Light Sand Door Frame Primer
tasks._doctrine_note: Trim: 400 LF/hr / 17 LF/frame ≈ 23 EA/hr. Trimmed to 15 EA/hr because frames have internal corners that slow sanding.

tasks.name: Touch Up Door Frame Caulk
tasks._doctrine_note: Trim caulk: 150 LF/hr; frame has ~4-6 LF of caulkable joints ≈ 10 EA/hr.

tasks.name: Clean Door Frame Dust Before Paint

doctrine: All rates per-frame (EA). Derivation based on standard 32x80 door frame with ~17 LF of trim equivalent. Flagged as gap-fill estimates — Phase 2 should field-validate against actual crew timings.
